newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-TNT to change division names under ACCC deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-TNT to change division names under ACCC deal.

text.p: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) said on Monday that TNT LTD would change the names of some divisions after the transport company misrepresented the way some goods were transported.
The competition watchdog said TNT sometimes transported goods by road after saying they would be transported by air.
Under the court-enforceable undertaking, TNT would shortly change the names of several divisions involved in express freight, removing the word "air", the ACCC said in a statement.
TNT would also write to customers the ACCC considered might have been affected, and to new customers up to December 31.
TNT also agreed to put together a programme to boost the trade practices education of its staff, the ACCC said.

"Importantly, TNT has undertaken that relevant customers over the past nine months will get a free freight satchel to transport goods to any Australian destination," ACCC chairman Allan Fels said in the statement.
"(TNT) advises that it will continue to use road transport facilities in certain circumstances. In future, TNT customers should be in no doubt that this may happen."
